arxiv-1907-00281.title: Improving 3D U-Net for Brain Tumor Segmentation by Utilizing Lesion Prior
arxiv-1907-00281.creator: Po-Yu Kao, Jefferson W. Chen, B.S. Manjunath
arxiv-1907-00281.description: Abstract We propose a novel, simple and effective method to integrate lesion prior and a 3D U-Net for improving brain tumor segmentation. First, we utilize the ground-truth brain tumor lesions from a group of patients to generate the heatmaps of different types of lesions.

arxiv-2011-12276.title: Insights From A Large-Scale Database of Material Depictions In Paintings
arxiv-2011-12276.creator: Hubert Lin ∗, Mitchell Van Zuijlen, Maarten W.A. Wijntjes, Sylvia C. Pont, Kavita Bala
arxiv-2011-12276.description: Abstract Deep learning has paved the way for strong recognition systems which are often both trained on and applied to natural images. In this paper, we examine the give-and-take relationship between such visual recognition systems and the rich information available in the fine arts.

arxiv-2012-15245.title: DDANet: Dual Decoder Attention Network for Automatic Polyp Segmentation
arxiv-2012-15245.creator: Nikhil Kumar Tomar, Debesh Jha, Sharib Ali, Håvard D. Johansen, Dag Johansen, Michael A. Riegler, Pål Halvorsen
arxiv-2012-15245.description: Abstract Colonoscopy is the gold standard for examination and detection of colorectal polyps. Localization and delineation of polyps can play a vital role in treatment (e.g., surgical planning) and prognostic decision making. Polyp segmentation can provide detailed boundary information for clinical analysis. Convolutional neural networks have improved the performance in colonoscopy.

arxiv-2106-06221.title: On continuous orbit equivalence rigidity for virtually cyclic group actions
arxiv-2106-06221.creator: Yongle Jiang
arxiv-2106-06221.description: Abstract . We prove that for any two continuous minimal (topologically free) actions of the infinite dihedral group on an infinite compact Hausdorff space, they are continuously orbit equivalent only if they are conjugate. We also show the above fails if we replace the infinite dihedral group with certain other virtually cyclic groups, e.g.

arxiv-2110-07656.title: Determinism Beyond Time Evolution
arxiv-2110-07656.creator: Emily Adlam
arxiv-2110-07656.description: Abstract Physicists are increasingly beginning to take seriously the possibility of laws outside the traditional time-evolution paradigm; yet many popular definitions of determinism are still predicated on a time-evolution picture, making them manifestly unsuited to the diverse range of research programmes in modern physics.

arxiv-2306-08269.title: Highly Accurate Prediction of NMR Chemical Shifts from Low-Level Quantum Mechanics Calculations Using Machine Learning
arxiv-2306-08269.creator: Jie Li, Jiashu Liang, Zhe Wang, Aleksandra L. Ptaszek, Xiao Liu, Brad Ganoe, Martin Head-Gordon, Teresa Head-Gordon
arxiv-2306-08269.description: Abstract Theoretical predictions of NMR chemical shifts from first-principles can greatly facilitate experimental interpretation and structure identification. However, accurate prediction of chemical shifts using the best coupled cluster methods can be prohibitively expensive for systems larger than ten to twenty non-hydrogen atoms on today’s computers.

arxiv-2309-03014.title: SymED: Adaptive and Online Symbolic Representation of Data on the Edge
arxiv-2309-03014.creator: Daniel Hofstätter, Shashikant Ilager, Ivan Lujic, Ivona Brandic
arxiv-2309-03014.description: Abstract The edge computing paradigm helps handle the Internet of Things (IoT) generated data in proximity to its source. Challenges occur in transferring, storing, and processing this rapidly growing amount of data on resource-constrained edge devices. Symbolic Representation (SR) algorithms are promising solutions to reduce the data size by converting actual raw data into symbols.

arxiv-2310-13233.title: Andreev probing of Cooper-pair flying qubit
arxiv-2310-13233.creator: S. Park, L. Y. Gorelik, S.I.Kulinich, H. C. Park, C.Kim, R. I. Shekhter
arxiv-2310-13233.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by S. Park, L. Y. Gorelik, S.I.Kulinich, H. C. Park, C.Kim, R. I. Shekhter. We propose a nanomechanical device which can actuate and probe a flying qubit that can be used to facilitate quantum information transfer over a long distance. The flying qubit is formed by a movable Cooper pair box (CPB) consisting of a superconducting dot and a bulk superconductor which are entangled by removing the Coulomb blockade of Cooper pair tunneling electrostatically.

arxiv-2402-08424.title: Conditional Neural Expert Processes for Learning Movement Primitives from Demonstration
arxiv-2402-08424.creator: Yigit YILDIRIM, Emre UGUR
arxiv-2402-08424.description: Abstract Learning from Demonstration (LfD) is a widely used technique for skill acquisition in robotics. However, demonstrations of the same skill may exhibit significant variances, or learning systems may attempt to acquire different means of the same skill simultaneously, making it challenging to encode these motions into movement primitives.

arxiv-2407-04362.title: Towards Context-aware Support for Color Vision Deficiency: An Approach Integrating LLM and AR
arxiv-2407-04362.creator: Shogo Morita 1 , Yan Zhang 2 , Takuto Yamauchi 3 , Sinan Chen 4 , Jialong Li 3 , Kenji Tei 1
arxiv-2407-04362.description: Abstract People with color vision deficiency often face challenges in distinguishing colors such as red and green, which can complicate daily tasks and require the use of assistive tools or environmental adjustments. Current support tools mainly focus on presentation-based aids, like the color vision modes found in iPhone accessibility settings.

arxiv-2503-08002.title: Predicting and Understanding College Student Mental Health with Interpretable Machine Learning
arxiv-2503-08002.creator: Meghna Roy Chowdhury, Wei Xuan, Shreyas Sen, Yixue Zhao, Yi Ding
arxiv-2503-08002.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Meghna Roy Chowdhury, Wei Xuan, Shreyas Sen, Yixue Zhao, Yi Ding. Mental health issues among college students have reached critical levels, affecting both academic performance and overall wellbeing. Predicting and understanding mental health status among college students is challenging due to three key barriers: the lack of large-scale longitudinal datasets, the prevalence of black-box machine learning models that offer little transparency, and a reliance on population-level analysis rather than personalized understanding.

arxiv-2508-01266.title: Frequency Dependent Polarizability for 1D Periodic Systems at Coupled Cluster with Single and Double Excitations Level
arxiv-2508-01266.creator: Marco Caricato, Taylor Parsons, Michael J. Frisch, Julia Abdoullaeva
arxiv-2508-01266.description: Abstract We report the first implementation of the frequency-dependent electric dipole-electric dipole polarizability for 1D periodic systems computed with the coupled cluster with single and double excitations (CCSD) method with periodic boundary conditions (PBCs). The implementation is performed in the CCResPy open-source software, based on Python and the NumPy library.

arxiv-2508-15713.title: Axisymmetric landslides on small planetary bodies
arxiv-2508-15713.creator: Kumar Gaurav \aff 1, Ishan Sharma \aff 1,2
arxiv-2508-15713.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Kumar Gaurav \aff 1, Ishan Sharma \aff 1,2. We aim to understand how landslides affect the shape and rotational motion of small rubble planetary bodies. We limit ourselves to axisymmetric global landslides, and take the primordial shape of the body to also be axisymmetric. The landslides are modeled through depth-averaging, while also incorporating the effect of the body’s rotation, topographical changes due to multiple landslides, the body’s non-uniform gravity field and possible surface mass shedding.

pmc-10737836.title: PREVALENCE AND PAYMENTS PER CAPITA OF ADRD IN PUERTO RICO AND THE US: ESTIMATES FROM MEDICARE DATA
pmc-10737836.creator: Jose Carrion-Baralt
pmc-10737836.description: Puerto Rico is one of the oldest US jurisdictions (22.7% aged 65 and over – 65+), where over 40% of the 65+ population lives under federal poverty levels. However, very little epidemiological and health economics research on Alzheimer’s Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) has been conducted on this population.

pmc-11461505.title: A perspective view of salt crystallization from solution in porous media: morphology, mechanism, and salt efflorescence
pmc-11461505.creator: Qiang Li, Zhongwei Wang, Han Guo, Jing Zhao, Hongjie Luo, Xiao Huang
pmc-11461505.description: Salt efflorescence is one of the major hazards to cultural heritages, masonries, and highways etc. It is now generally accepted that damages caused by salt efflorescence are mainly due to continuous cycles of salt crystallization/dissolution or hydration/dehydration in confined spaces.

pmc-11585603.title: Effects of additional weight-bearing on the in vivo kinematics of the human ankle joint complex during walking
pmc-11585603.creator: Shengli Wang, Zhihui Qian, Xiangyu Liu, Guangsheng Song, Zhende Jiang, Kunyang Wang, Jianan Wu, Jing Liu, Lei Ren, Luquan Ren
pmc-11585603.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Studies focusing on the kinematics of the ankle joint complex (AJC) have long been a key area of interest for biomechanists and orthopedic surgeons. However, it is not clear how additional weight-bearing walking affects the motion of the AJC compared to walking with a normal body weight (BW) or what adjustments the AJC would instinctively make to accommodate the additional load.

pmc-11647406.title: Effect of grain vinegar feeding on milk production and fatty acid profile of Holstein cows
pmc-11647406.creator: Seongjin Oh, Tomohiro Mitani, Masahito Kawai, Koichiro Ueda
pmc-11647406.description: Incorporating organic acids into cattle feed should be carefully considered because dietary organic acids may affect voluntary feed intake and rumen fermentation. We conducted a feeding trial for the practical evaluation of grain vinegar. Lactating Holstein cows (n = 19) were divided into two groups, then were subjected to each of two treatments in a crossover design.

pmc-12693541.title: Burden of Healthcare-Associated Infections on Mortality Among COVID-19 Hospitalized Patients
pmc-12693541.creator: Corina Voinea, Elena Mocanu, Elena Dantes, Sanda Jurja, Ana-Maria Neculai, Aurora Craciun, Sorin Rugina
pmc-12693541.description: Background: Healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) are a significant public health problem, having a decisive impact on the prognosis of patients hospitalized with COVID-19. In Romania, the absence of a uniform reporting system and the lack of epidemiological data comparable to European standards limit the real assessment of their incidence and consequences.

pmc-12714811.title: FTO-Mediated Mitigation of Ferroptosis Occurs in an ACSL4-Dependent Manner in Diabetic Cardiomyopathy
pmc-12714811.creator: Xin-xin Chen, Yan Gu, Zhe Yin, Yu-tang Li, Zhan-chuan Ma, Wei Wang, Yun-qing Hou, Xiang Wang
pmc-12714811.description: Considering the global prevalence of diabetes, diabetic cardiomyopathy (DCM), as a significant diabetes complication, remains a major human challenge; while previous studies have identified ferroptosis as an important underlying mechanism, the unclear regulatory mechanisms hamper the development of therapy for DCM.

pmc-13230275.title: Comparison of LISA and INSURE techniques for surfactant administration: a multicentre retrospective study
pmc-13230275.creator: Raffaella Panza, Rossella Caravita, Luigia Valenzano, Domenico Martinelli, Ilaria Farella, Pietro Guida, Michele Quercia, Giuseppe Latorre, Nicola Laforgia
pmc-13230275.description: NIV and early targeted endotracheal surfactant administration play a pivotal role in the treatment of RDS and other respiratory conditions in neonates. LISA and INSURE are the most widely used techniques for surfactant delivery. This multicentre retrospective registry-based cohort study, conducted in three Southern Italy Neonatal Intensive Care Units between January 2024 and March 2025, aimed to compare their effectiveness.

pmc-13311941.title: Non-atherosclerotic myocardial infarction in hypereosinophilic syndrome: emerging insights and therapeutic approaches
pmc-13311941.creator: Jiao Li, Wenjun Jia, Qi Li, Yue Liu, Zhenying Zhou, Liping Wei

pmc-13324691.title: Evaluation of shape recovery algorithm for translucent objects
pmc-13324691.creator: Takeaki Shimokawa
pmc-13324691.description: The human visual system can estimate the three-dimensional shapes of translucent objects. However, the shape estimation of translucent objects is less accurate than that of opaque objects. The specular component is particularly important in the shape perception of translucent objects because it is robust, whereas the non-specular component is affected by translucency.

pmc-13342501.title: Potential of Rumex japonicus Houtt. in alkaline soil management
pmc-13342501.creator: Yueming Zhao, Xianghua Zuo, Yuqiao Gong, Jian You, Xia Chen
pmc-13342501.description: Soil alkalization is a major abiotic factor that has a detrimental impact on soil health and crop productivity. To restore and enhance the use of alkaline soils, it is critical to search for alkaline-tolerant plant species with economic value. In this study, we investigated the potential of Rumex japonicus Houtt. as a commercial medicinal crop in alkaline soil.

pmc-13556740.title: 214. Magnetic seizure therapy for major depressive disorder: clinical efficacy, safety, and prefrontal activation measured by functional near-infrared spectroscopy
pmc-13556740.creator: R Wang, L Jiao, C An
pmc-13556740.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundMagnetic seizure therapy (MST) is an emerging convulsive neuromodulation technique that may achieve antidepressant efficacy comparable to electroconvulsive therapy (ECT) while minimizing cognitive adverse effects. However, neurophysiological mechanisms underlying its therapeutic action remain incompletely characterized.Aims & ObjectivesTo evaluate the clinical efficacy and safety of MST in patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) and to assess treatment-related cerebral hemodynamic changes using functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS).MethodThis prospective, open-label clinical trial was conducted at the Mental Health Center, First Hospital of Hebei Medical University, Shijiazhuang,

pmc-13583683.title: Perception of safety climate among nursing staff in operating rooms in Slovenia: a cross-sectional analytical study
pmc-13583683.creator: Igor Karnjuš, Margareta Kotar Bunderla, Patrik Pucer
pmc-13583683.description: Objectives(1) To determine the perceived level of safety climate among nursing staff in operating rooms (ORs) in Slovenia; (2) to investigate correlations and differences between professional position, length of service, healthcare level and perceived safety climate and (3) to identify independent predictors of overall and domain-specific safety climate perceptions.DesignA cross-sectional non-experimental quantitative analytical study.
